name: Belmond Villa Sant' Andrea
positioning: Belmond Villa Sant'Andrea, a seaside hotel at Taormina Mare in Sicily, originally built in 1919 as a family escape and now with a beach club, boat tours and several restaurants
best_for: Travelers who want a Sicilian seaside stay with a beach club and boat tours
Families with children aged 4-12, who can join Smile Club

facts.text: The hotel has welcomed guests since the 1950s.
The hotel offers watersports and boat tours.
A complimentary shuttle runs to Grand Hotel Timeo in the town centre.
Ristorante Sant'Andrea serves relaxed Sicilian seafood.
Brace offers a coastal grill experience.
Gwendoline's Bar is an indoor mid-century modern bar.
Smile Club is offered for kids aged 4-12.
Experiences from the hotel include volcanic vineyards and coastal exploration.
The hotel hosts intimate ceremonial weddings and blessings.

highlights.text: Lido Villeggiatura is the beach club of Villa Sant'Andrea.
The hotel has a heated outdoor infinity pool.
The hotel offers a complimentary 90-minute group boat tour.
Villa Sant'Andrea was originally built in 1919 as an escape for an aristocratic family.
Brizza offers elevated water's edge dining.

considerations.text: The hotel is a 1-hour drive from Catania Airport.
The complimentary boat tour is a group tour.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
